column7: Cloudflare detected via cf-ray header. Recommend proxying via Burp or mitmproxy to avoid TLS fingerprint blocks.
SSL Certificate Issuer: /C=US/O=CLOUDFLARE, INC./CN=Cloudflare TLS Issuing ECC CA 1
